item.text: {"search_note":"I found no strong 2024 evidence that Biden’s main industrial, infrastructure, or workforce programs were systematically reserved for regime supporters. The best evidence points the other way, toward broad geographic spread and explicit inclusion goals. The weakest point is student-debt relief, where the distribution is inherently narrower because it helps borrowers with college debt, and the politics around it were openly aimed at younger and Democratic-leaning constituencies. A lot of the positive evidence comes from agency releases and program summaries, so it is strong on intent and rollout but less definitive than an independent microdistribution
